svg.aria-label: Secure by default: Security is designed in from the first line, not patched on at the end.; Built for the field: Offline-first and lightweight, because networks and devices are not always fast.; Tested and readable: Tests, clear names and short functions keep the code easy to maintain.; Stack on purpose: I pick tools for the constraints of the project, not for the hype.
